title: BECE Basic Technology & Computer Science - Basic Technology - Road Signs
subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: A circular road sign with a red border usually indicates:
questions.explain: Circular signs with red borders are regulatory signs indicating prohibitions (what you must not do) or mandatory orders.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: What does a triangular road sign pointing upwards indicate?
questions.explain: Triangular signs with the apex pointing up are warning signs alerting drivers to hazards ahead (e.g., 'Bend ahead', 'Narrow bridge').
questions.subject: Basic Technology
